title: Can cryptographic execution timing add useful information to latency diagnosis?
description: V-DAP is an experimental Rust engine designed to measure cryptographic execution timing to explore whether such measurements can provide useful diagnostic information for latency issues beyond conventional observability tools. Preliminary experiments show a correlation between cryptographic timing intervals and total request latency, but the project does not claim production readiness or proven diagnostic advantage. The research is ongoing to determine if V-DAP can distinguish causes of latency and improve diagnostic accuracy compared to existing methods.
